relationships.evidence: worldsteel states that the LCI study follows ISO 14040 and ISO 14044.
relationships.constraints: Conformance details depend on study report and review.
relationships.validation_question: Review current detailed study report when published.

relationships.evidence: Both provide industry-average steel-sector LCI, with EUROFER focused on European stainless products.
relationships.constraints: Products, system boundaries, allocation and data years can differ.
relationships.validation_question: Develop a product-, region-, method- and vintage-specific concordance.
